instructions: Say to your AI: "Record what happened to this task", and give it as (the one making the move), id (the task), action and what the action needs (result, because, words or assignees).
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:change-a-task and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Makes the move the rules allow for the one making it, as one write of the whole task; a move the rules do not allow is refused with the reason.
